# Godoy's Wolves Tree Service & Landscape LLC

> Family owned and Latinx owned landscaping, tree service, irrigation, drainage, concrete removal, and commercial grounds maintenance contractor based in Plano, Texas, serving the Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex and Grayson County.

## Entity & Contact Facts
* Legal Name: Godoy's Wolves Tree Service & Landscape LLC (DBA Godoy's Wolves LLC)
* Owner & Operator: Rafael Godoy (on site for estimates and project supervision)
* Headquarters: Plano, TX 75074 (Serving Dallas, Collin, Denton, Tarrant, Rockwall, and Grayson Counties)
* Primary Phone (Call or Text): (469) 301-6801
* Email: godoyswolves.treeservice@gmail.com
* Website: https://godoyswolves.com/
* Google Business Profile: 5.0 stars across 29 verified Google reviews (https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=9606151952738318712)
* Hours: Monday to Friday 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (24/7 emergency storm response)
* Languages Spoken: English and Spanish
* Credentials: Fully licensed and insured in Texas; TCEQ licensed irrigation technicians; ISA standard pruning; oak wilt aware scheduling (no routine oak pruning February through June without immediate wound sealing)
* Named Commercial Clients: PetSmart, Dallas Zoo, Harbor Freight, Best Buy, Burger King, EZ Mart

## Core Services & Typical DFW Pricing Bands
* Tree Removal: Small trees under 25 ft ($200 to $500); medium trees 25 to 50 ft ($500 to $1,500); large or complex removals over 50 ft near structures or power lines ($1,500 to $4,000+)
* Tree Trimming & Structural Pruning: Crown thinning, canopy lifting, structural reduction, deadwood removal, and crape myrtle care ($150 to $800+ per tree; we never top trees)
* Stump Grinding & Root Chasing: Ground 12 inches below grade so the spot accepts sod or new planting ($100 to $400 per stump, same day available)
* Emergency Storm Response: Seven day emergency dispatch for fallen limbs, uprooted trees, blocked driveways, and roof hazards with insurance documentation
* Commercial Landscaping & Grounds Maintenance: Weekly mowing, edging, bed maintenance, seasonal color, tree care, irrigation management, and porter service for retail centers, HOAs, medical offices, and campuses
* Residential Landscaping & Sod Installation: Custom landscape design, Bermuda, St. Augustine, and Zoysia sod installation, flowerbeds, mulch, river rock, retaining walls, and wood or iron fencing
* Builders & New Home Construction Packages: Final grade, drainage swales, irrigation installation, sod pallets, shade trees, and hardscape coordinated to builder closing dates
* Sprinkler & Irrigation Repair: TCEQ licensed repair for valves, controllers, broken heads, wiring faults, drip zones, and underground main line leaks
* French Drain Installation & Yard Drainage: Perforated pipe in washed gravel trenches, catch basins, downspout tie ins, and regrading for North Texas expansive clay soils
* Concrete Removal & Demolition: Hydraulic skid steer breaker demolition and same trip haul off for driveways, patios, slabs, sidewalks, and pool decks
* Junk Removal & Property Cleanouts: Same day hauling for green waste, brush piles, construction debris, old fencing, appliances, and full property cleanouts
* Christmas Lights Installation & Removal (Residential & Commercial): Turnkey C9 LED roofline outlining ($450 to $1,800+), mature live oak trunk and canopy wrapping, walkways, patios, commercial and HOA monument displays ($1,200 to $6,000+), in season maintenance, and January takedown across Garland, Dallas, Plano, Rockwall, Rowlett, Richardson, Mesquite, and DFW
* Godoy's Ranch: North Texas horse breeding program featuring SB Snooby (Sport Friesian) and Parrandero (Half Arabian)
